name: Deliberate Distortion: Dissonance
source:
Major Katsuragi's usual morning begins with an unusual call - Ritsuko tells her that Shinji is in trouble and tries to understand how Misato, the tactical commander of the Evangelion pilots, could have forgotten about it. Misato herself is confused. Trying to remember the details of the previous day, she leaves the house.

[Translated from [url=https://hd-team.info/home/deliberate-distortion-dissonance.html]HD-team[/url]]
translation:
葛城少校平常的早晨以一通不寻常的电话开始——律子告诉她，真嗣遇到了麻烦，同时试图弄明白，身为EVA驾驶员战术指挥官的美里为何会忘记此事。美里自己也困惑不已。为了回忆前一天的细节，她离开了家。

[Translated from [url=https://hd-team.info/home/deliberate-distortion-dissonance.html]HD-team[/url]]
